UpSet Plot Type

Source: R/type_upset.R
type_upset.Rd

Creates publication-ready UpSet plots for visualizing set intersections. An alternative to Venn diagrams that scales to many sets: the top panel shows intersection sizes as bars, the bottom panel shows a membership dot matrix, and (optionally) the left panel shows set sizes. Inspired by cnsplots' upsetplot().

Usage

type_upset(
  sets = NULL,
  sort_by = c("size", "degree"),
  max_rank = NULL,
  min_size = 0,
  bar_color = "#3C5488",
  point_color = "#3C5488",
  set_color = "#E64B35",
  show_set_sizes = TRUE,
  show_size_labels = TRUE,
  bar_width = 0.68
)

Arguments

sets

Optional named list of sets (vectors of elements). When NULL, sets are resolved from the data: a named list passed as x, or a data frame of binary membership columns.

sort_by

Sort intersections by "size" (default) or "degree" (number of sets in the intersection).

max_rank

Maximum number of intersections to show (default NULL = all observed intersections).

min_size

Only show intersections with at least this many elements (default 0).

bar_color

Color of the intersection-size bars (default "#3C5488").

point_color

Color of the membership dots (default "#3C5488").

set_color

Color of the set-size bars (default "#E64B35").

show_set_sizes

Show the set-size panel on the left (default TRUE).

show_size_labels

Label intersection sizes above bars (default TRUE).

bar_width

Width of the intersection bars (default 0.68).

Value

A cliplot_type object for use with cliplot. The composed figure requires patchwork; when patchwork is not installed a single-panel bar chart of intersection sizes is returned.

Details

Pass a named list of sets as the first argument, or a data frame of binary membership columns (rows = items, columns = sets). Only intersections that actually occur in the data are shown, matching UpSetR behaviour.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Named list of sets
sets = list(Treatment_A = c("TP53", "BRCA1", "MYC"),
            Treatment_B = c("TP53", "KRAS", "APC"),
            Control     = c("TP53", "MYC", "RB1"))
cliplot(sets, type = "upset")

# Binary membership data frame
cliplot(deg_binary, type = "upset", theme = "nature")
} # }
